correctness.rationale: The complete-reset Markov generator yields the stationary orientation, mixed, and transverse second moments; its conditional correlation system solves exactly. The universal right slope isolates r; a Prony determinant recovers the two decay poles when nonzero; the stationary variance strictly distinguishes their physical assignment, and a cancelled-pole quadratic recovers the missing trap mode. A rational example and 1,409 rational and separately formulated finite-matrix diagnostics check boundary cases, but the proof rather than the tests establishes all-parameter injectivity.

value.rationale: An entire stationary coordinate time series, with no orientation observation, carries sufficient exact information to separate angular diffusion, trap decay, and reset frequency. The nontrivial part is resolving physical pole ordering and rigorously recovering a trap pole that can cancel exactly. This supplies a natural structural calibration theorem, demonstrates a hidden-mode boundary of naive spectral fitting, and avoids claiming measurement-noise stability.
